records.translation: Alinear las divisiones de una película y compararlas con controles emparejados.

records.context: Runs the steps of this module in order. Divisions are read with :func:`division_events`; ``mode='auto'`` keeps whichever kind, fission or budding, the movie has more of. Each division is checked (parent seen at ``t_div`` and on 80% of the window, daughters seen on the next frame, two daughters for a fission). The kept divisions get size-matched controls (:func:`match_controls`) and a shuffled alignment (:func:`shuffled_alignment`) with its own size-matched controls, so the null runs the same matching at a random time. The late-vs-baseline change of every unit (:func:`unit_changes`) is compared as Hedges' g (:func:`effect_size`), dividing against control and shuffled against its control. Complete fission cycles give the size-control fits.
records.label: spacr.division_analysis.analyse_divisions#1
records.source: Runs the steps of this module in order. Divisions are read with :func:`division_events`; ``mode='auto'`` keeps whichever kind, fission or budding, the movie has more of. Each division is checked (parent seen at ``t_div`` and on 80% of the window, daughters seen on the next frame, two daughters for a fission). The kept divisions get size-matched controls (:func:`match_controls`) and a shuffled alignment (:func:`shuffled_alignment`) with its own size-matched controls, so the null runs the same matching at a random time. The late-vs-baseline change of every unit (:func:`unit_changes`) is compared as Hedges' g (:func:`effect_size`), dividing against control and shuffled against its control. Complete fission cycles give the size-control fits.
records.translation: Ejecuta en orden los pasos de este módulo. Las divisiones se leen con :func:`division_events`; ``mode='auto'`` conserva el tipo, fisión o gemación, más frecuente en la película. Se comprueba cada división (progenitor visto en ``t_div`` y en el 80% de la ventana, hijas vistas en el fotograma siguiente, dos hijas en una fisión). Las divisiones conservadas reciben controles emparejados por tamaño (:func:`match_controls`) y una alineación aleatorizada (:func:`shuffled_alignment`) con sus propios controles emparejados por tamaño, de modo que el control nulo realiza el mismo emparejamiento en un tiempo aleatorio. El cambio de cada unidad entre la ventana basal y la tardía (:func:`unit_changes`) se compara como Hedges' g (:func:`effect_size`): las que se dividen frente a su control y la alineación aleatorizada frente al suyo. Los ciclos de fisión completos proporcionan los ajustes del control del tamaño.

records.label: spacr.ops_flatfield#0
records.source: Flat-field maps for optical pooled screen phenotype fields, and two ways to apply them.
records.translation: Mapas de campo plano para los campos de fenotipo de cribados ópticos agrupados, y dos formas de aplicarlos.

records.context: A 20X phenotype microscope field of view is not evenly lit: on laboratory microplate A of Funk et al. 2022 the corners receive about half the light of the centre. A cell measured in a corner then reads dimmer than the same cell in the middle, and in a pooled screening experiment, where each guide's cells sit at random positions, that adds noise to every intensity feature and biases the cells near the edge.
records.label: spacr.ops_flatfield#1
records.source: A 20X phenotype field is not evenly lit: on plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the corners receive about half the light of the centre. A cell measured in a corner then reads dimmer than the same cell in the middle, and in a pooled screen, where each guide's cells sit at random positions, that adds noise to every intensity feature and biases the cells near the edge.
records.translation: Un campo de fenotipo de 20X no está iluminado de forma uniforme: en la placa A de Funk et al. 2022, las esquinas reciben aproximadamente la mitad de luz que el centro. Una célula medida en una esquina aparece entonces más tenue que la misma célula en el centro y, en un cribado agrupado, donde las células de cada guía se sitúan en posiciones aleatorias, eso añade ruido a todas las características de intensidad y sesga las células cercanas al borde.

records.context: THE MAP. Per laboratory microplate and channel, a few hundred microscope fields of view are read, block-averaged in 16 x 16 pixel blocks, and the per-block median over the microscope fields of view is taken. Cells move from microscope field of view to microscope field of view while the illumination does not, so the median keeps the illumination and loses the cells. It is smoothed with a Gaussian (sigma 6 blocks, about 96 microscope field of view pixels); the nuclear channel, whose sparse bright nuclei leave a noisier median, is then fitted with a 4th-order 2-D polynomial. The camera and background offset ``b`` is the 0.1th percentile of every block mean, and the map is ``flat = (smooth - b) / (centre - b)``: 1 at the centre. It is floored at 0.25, so no pixel is multiplied by more than 4.
records.label: spacr.ops_flatfield#2
records.source: THE MAP. Per plate and channel, a few hundred fields are read, block-averaged in 16 x 16 pixel blocks, and the per-block median over the fields is taken. Cells move from field to field while the illumination does not, so the median keeps the illumination and loses the cells. It is smoothed with a Gaussian (sigma 6 blocks, about 96 field pixels); the nuclear channel, whose sparse bright nuclei leave a noisier median, is then fitted with a 4th-order 2-D polynomial. The camera and background offset ``b`` is the 0.1th percentile of every block mean, and the map is ``flat = (smooth - b) / (centre - b)``: 1 at the centre. It is floored at 0.25, so no pixel is multiplied by more than 4.
records.translation: EL MAPA. Por placa y canal se leen unos cientos de campos, se promedian en bloques de 16 x 16 píxeles y se toma la mediana por bloque a lo largo de los campos. Las células se desplazan de un campo a otro mientras que la iluminación no, por lo que la mediana conserva la iluminación y pierde las células. Se suaviza con un filtro gaussiano (sigma 6 bloques, unos 96 píxeles del campo); el canal nuclear, cuyos núcleos brillantes y dispersos dejan una mediana más ruidosa, se ajusta después con un polinomio de orden 4 en 2-D. El desplazamiento de la cámara y del fondo ``b`` es el percentil 0.1 de todas las medias de bloque, y el mapa es ``flat = (smooth - b) / (centre - b)``: 1 en el centro. Se le aplica un mínimo de 0.25, de modo que ningún píxel se multiplica por más de 4.

records.translation: PERTENENCIA AL INTERIOR SEGÚN EL CENTROIDE DE SECUENCIACIÓN (A1b).
